name: prereqs possible
verbose: Check if it is possible to take all courses.

node.prompt:
## prereqs possible

Write a function, _prereqsPossible_, that takes in a number of courses (n) and prerequisites as
arguments. Courses have ids ranging from 0 through n - 1. A single prerequisite of [A, B] means that
course A must be taken _before_ course B. The function should return a boolean indicating whether or
not it is possible to complete all courses.

#### test_00:

```js
const numCourses = 6;
const prereqs = [
  [0, 1],
  [2, 3],
  [0, 2],
  [1, 3],
  [4, 5],
];
prereqsPossible(numCourses, prereqs); // -> true
```

#### test_01:

```js
const numCourses = 6;
const prereqs = [
  [0, 1],
  [2, 3],
  [0, 2],
  [1, 3],
  [4, 5],
  [3, 0],
];
prereqsPossible(numCourses, prereqs); // -> false
```

#### test_02:

```js
const numCourses = 5;
const prereqs = [
  [2, 4],
  [1, 0],
  [0, 2],
  [0, 4],
];
prereqsPossible(numCourses, prereqs); // -> true
```

#### test_03:

```js
const numCourses = 6;
const prereqs = [

  [3, 5],
];
prereqsPossible(numCourses, prereqs); // -> false
```

#### test_04:

```js
const numCourses = 8;
const prereqs = [
  [1, 0],
  [0, 6],
  [2, 0],

  [3, 7],
  [4, 3],
];
prereqsPossible(numCourses, prereqs); // -> true
```

#### test_05:

```js
const numCourses = 8;
const prereqs = [
  [1, 0],
  [0, 6],
  [2, 0],
  [0, 5],
  [3, 7],
  [7, 4],
  [4, 3],
];
prereqsPossible(numCourses, prereqs); // -> false
```

#### test_06:

```js
const numCourses = 42;
const prereqs = [[6, 36]];
prereqsPossible(numCourses, prereqs); // -> true
```
